checks: Workspace retrieves all six status counts and persisted application cards.
Backend status filtering, company search, and overdue display work.
Client validation prevents empty save; a valid application persists through the frontend.
Prefilled editing changes allowed fields and keeps the applied date disabled.
Only valid next statuses are offered; status changes persist with a visible timeline and disabled deletion in Interview/Offer.
Final status locks further changes; deletion asks for confirmation and honours both cancellation and approval.
Frontend rejects future dates and displays a backend 409 duplicate message without clearing the form.
Pagination loads both pages; no-match search shows a helpful empty state.
A simulated API failure shows a retry control and retry recovers persisted results.
Dashboard, timeline, and form pass 390px layout/accessibility checks; detail deep-link refresh works.
